Posco (PKX) Holder Corecommodity Management Has Cut Its Position by $600,366; As Schlumberger LTD (SLB) Market Value Rose, Kelly Lawrence W & Associates Boosted Its Holding
June 19, 2018 - By Henry Gaston
Corecommodity Management Llc decreased its stake in Posco (PKX) by 63.35% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Corecommodity Management Llc sold 7,697 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.02% with the market. The institutional investor held 4,453 shares of the steel and iron ore company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $351,000, down from 12,150 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Corecommodity Management Llc who had been investing in Posco for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $25.84 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 4.98% or $4.06 during the last trading session, reaching $77.54. About 137,929 shares traded. POSCO (NYSE:PKX) has risen 27.23% since June 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 14.66% the S&P500. Kelly Lawrence W & Associates Inc increased its stake in Schlumberger Ltd (SLB) by 80.9% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Kelly Lawrence W & Associates Inc bought 92,595 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.80% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 207,053 shares of the oilfield services and equipment company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $13.41 million, up from 114,458 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Kelly Lawrence W & Associates Inc who had been investing in Schlumberger Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $91.11 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.89% or $1.2656 during the last trading session, reaching $65.7744. About 5.43 million shares traded.
